# #9: Update currencies from latest ISO

There is a change of ANG to XCG that comes into effect as of July 1, 2025.

We will also need to decide how we will deal with obsolete currencies, as XCG is replacing ANG with the same numeric value.
Maybe a deprecated flag for ones like this?
